text:
maria: Morning async — quick standup. What I did: rolled kv-warmup padding tweak to canary, ran perf job against staging, observed ~0.5% p50 regression in eu-west canary. Blockers: I don’t have memprof logs access for the canary nodes (403). Today: bisect the change, open runbook if we need rollback.
ajay: saw the same blip on our dashboards. digging into batcher queue lat distribution now. can you paste the canary id?
maria: canary id: canary-4b7. Also snapshot of the canary config: `batcher.max_batch_tokens=512`, `kv_padding=low`.
ajay: thx. pulled logs at 09:12 UTC — there’s a short spike when eviction GC ran. link: https://logs.redwood.internal/archives/abc123 
lee: oncall here — if p95 climbs over 300ms we should escalate and consider rollback. I can hold the pager if we need to run a rollback. :thumbsup: 
sre-bot: [ALERT] p95 latency spike detected in eu-west batcher at 09:12 UTC — p95=412ms, affected requests ~0.6% — incident-category: latency.
maria: noted. opening a quick PR for runbook edits and adding a sample curl to reproduce locally. @devon can you review the runbook and the PR?
devon: will review in ~30m. small nit — add a curl + header example and an expected response snippet. Also add the metric query we used to detect spike.
maria: added snippet in PR: ```curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate``` and query: `sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="batcher",le=\"0.3\"}[5m]))`
ajay: quick check in staging — enabling kv_padding=medium removes the eviction churn in the test run. I’ll run a 1-hour soak.
lee: if that stabilizes, we can promote the config change. otherwise rollback target rev is 1.2.3-prod (stable from last night). I verified rollback playbook.
maria: thanks. if soak passes I’ll cut a small canary rollout to 10% with kv_padding=medium and monitor p95 for 30m. will update here.
devon: reviewed runbook and left a small comment on the metric name. LGTM otherwise.
maria: update: soak looks promising so far (20m in). will schedule the 10% rollout at 10:40 UTC and post results. thanks team.
